_meta.name: travel_context_triggers
_meta.description: AI-copy structural patterns that cannot be cleanly swapped by regex (they span whole sentences, require agreement with surrounding text, or need the sentence reshaped around a human variant). The regex engine only FLAGS these matches. A downstream LLM step (n8n OpenAI node, optional intake-page call) rewrites the flagged sentence, pasting one of the pre-approved 'human_variants' VERBATIM into the reshape. If the LLM fails to include a variant character-for-character, the flagged span is left as-is (regex-layer safe fallback). Human variants are drawn from human_corpus.json (2,307 real forum sentences). | v1.4.0: variants tightened via strict positive+negative filters (no brand-name noise, no vulgarities, no off-topic anecdotes).
_meta.guardrail: LLM output must contain exactly one 'human_variants' entry, character-for-character. Otherwise, discard rewrite and keep original.
_meta.notes: · v1.5 added corpus-tagged variants mined from expanded 2,840-phrase corpus. · v1.5.1 pruned off-niche corpus imports (Windstar/Cunard/Yucatan/etc) and added Latin-America-focused replacements.
